description: This file defines the NamedTensorMeta class and related utilities for managing tensor dimension names within the ATen library, handling dependencies between ATen and c10 components, and providing mechanisms for name validation and management.

classes.name: NamedTensorMeta
classes.description: Manages tensor dimension names with invariants ensuring at least one non-wildcard name.

classes.name: NamesMode
classes.description: Controls whether tensor names are enabled or ignored.

classes.name: NoNamesGuard
classes.description: RAII guard to temporarily disable tensor names within a scope.

methods.name: names
methods.description: Returns the list of dimension names.

methods.name: slow_dim
methods.description: Returns the number of dimension names.

methods.name: check_invariants
methods.description: Ensures at least one name is non-wildcard.

methods.name: set_names
methods.description: Sets new dimension names, ensuring invariants.

methods.name: is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if names mode is enabled.
